name: Phu Quoc resort living
summary: West-coast sunset strips and southern capes where villa pools and beach clubs are the reason to fly south.
body: Phu Quoc is an island stay, not a day trip from Ho Chi Minh City. Long Beach carries the densest resort row. The south cape is quieter and farther from Duong Dong.
These names are the luxury and premium properties named on their own sites. They are not ranked. Compare location and transfer time before you book.

properties.name: JW Marriott Phu Quoc Emerald Bay Resort & Spa
properties.summary: Bill Bensley design on Bai Khem beach at the island’s south end.

properties.name: Premier Village Phu Quoc Resort
properties.summary: Accor-managed pool villas on Ong Doi Cape with sea on both sides.
